import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

        return json.load(f)

# 2. RSFT CED (4 seeds)

ced_s43 = load("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/rsft_ced_s43/metrics.json")

# 3. RSFT flat-NLI (2 seeds)

fnli_s43 = load("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/rsft_flat_nli_s43_reeval_r2/metrics.json")

# 4. GRPO QLoRA (ced_kl001 ckpt-100)
grpo_qlora = load("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/grpo_ced_kl001_step100/checkpoint-100/metrics.json")

# 5. GRPO bf16 G=8 (ckpt-100)
grpo_bf16 = load("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/grpo_g8_bf16_ckpt100/metrics.json")

# 6. DPO 1ep (fixed)
dpo_1ep = load("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/dpo_ced_1ep_fixed/metrics.json")

    return np.mean([m[key] for m in metrics_list])
